Digital marketing portfolio shows how SEO implementation, performance-based marketing, and constant optimization have helped the brand increase its standing in the market for perfume. sections.title: Facebook Growth
sections.body: A major and evident change that can be seen by the graphs shows the increase of organic search traffic as well as search results. This is a sign of the effectiveness of targeted keyword strategies as well as technological optimization employed by the company. With a focus on search terms and enhancing site structure, Luhaif was successful in reaching a wider market of consumers searching for fragrances on the internet. The digital marketing portfolio of the campaign also shows the importance of a structured digital marketing portfolio that showcases the measurable growth, analysis and successful branding campaigns for companies looking to establish themselves as leaders on the internet.

sections.title: Instagram Growth
sections.body: Engagement numbers in the graphs indicate users are spending increased time on site as well as browsing product pages. Increased click-through rate as well as % of returning customers means that strategy around content and customer experience improvement has successfully garnered potential buyers. Strong visual branding, clear product descriptions and search visibility have resulted in higher customer confidence and conversion opportunities. These enhancements are crucial for perfume companies in which customer perception and presentation have a significant impact on purchasing behaviour. Research has also shown that customer engagement and their discovery of fragrances significantly affect the purchasing decisions of perfume.
